title: Tsurizao Hitotsu de Isekai Hourou
titleNative: 釣り竿ひとつで異世界放浪
synonyms: Wandering Around Another World with Just One Fishing Rod
synopsis: Owari Machida was a professional fisherman who made a name for himself in the media, but his former glory proved short-lived, and he struggles everyday to make ends meet. One day, while out boat fishing, he gets swept away by the waves and fell into the sea, losing consciousness as he downs because of a malfunction of his life jacket. When Owari awakens, the scenery has completely changed—he finds himself in an Isekai... In this world where the culture of fishing has declined, Owari wanders around enjoying fishing with the fishing gear that transmigrated with him, while interacting with the locals... (Source: Shinchosha, translated)

synopsis: Morimoto, a young professional woman in Japan, is tired of fending off her parents' questions about her being single. synopsis: “Make me a princess!” One day, Yuma Kanbara finds himself in a tough spot, when his younger sister, Ayane, blackmails him with a certain cringe-worthy secret from his past. Her demand? To secure her a spot among the “Hime 6,” the prestigious titles awarded only to the top six candidates in Himegasaki Academy’s famous general election. Determined to claim the throne, Ayane leverages Yuma's weakness to make him “conquer” her rival princess candidates to clear the path to her victory. But winning over the school’s most captivating beauties is no easy task, and Yuuma struggles at every turn… Worse still, as he gets involved with the girls, he finds himself getting tangled up in the increasingly complicated romantic lives of the princesses themselves! With egos laid bare and love and scheming colliding at full force, the most chaotic romantic comedy ever is about to begin! (Source: SB Creative, translated)

When a chance meeting at her new job with childhood friend, fellow otaku , and now coworker Hirotaka Nifuji almost gets her secret outed at work, she comes up with a plan to make sure he never speaks up. (Source: Kodansha USA) Notes: - Includes 29 extra chapters. - The English edition combines 2 Japanese volumes into one each (so e.g. the first two Japanese volumes are combined into 1 English volume).
